title: OFM model cache status
description: Payload of ofm/_system/cache/{runtime}: state of one runtime's model cache (ADR-0001). Published retained after every cache load and whenever the unmapped count changes.

ts.description: Time of the last successful cache load.

trigger.description: What caused the last load: startup (Phase 1) or a model_changed notification (Phase 2).

rows.description: Number of rows loaded from vw_runtime_model.

unmapped.description: Number of distinct unmapped (source, address) pairs seen since the last load.
